caseNameFull: Erie Railroad Company, in Error v. Blanche Russell, Administratrix, etc.
disposition: Motion to dismiss or affirm and petition for writ of certiorari submitted March 20, 1911.
summary: Error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Frederic B. Jennings for the plaintiff in error and petitioner., Mr. George A. Clement for the defendant in error and respondent.

opinions.text:
Dismissed for want of jurisdiction.

Petition for writ of certiorari denied.
